MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Ring camera and Blink doorbell feel like useful additions to my Alexa setup because they add security functions alongside the Echo devices I already own.",
    "The portable monitor and USB power strip fit my history of adding practical computer accessories, although neither solves an immediate need for me."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 stand does not fit my Echo Show 5, and the older Echo Dot offers little reason to buy after my fourth-generation Dot.",
    "The thermostat requires a heating-system compatibility check, while the tablet and HDMI coupler lack a clear purpose in my current setup.",
    "The whole-home security bundle is related to my interests, but I would try one camera or doorbell before committing to several devices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Alexa devices seems to be treated as a reason to want almost any Alexa-related product, even when it duplicates something I own or fits a different model.",
    "My history of buying electronics accessories seems to imply that I currently need more accessories, even without a specific problem to solve."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases identify the exact devices I use: an Echo Show 5 with its stand and a fourth-generation Echo Dot. Compatibility and what I already own matter to my next choice.",
    "A useful new function matters more to me than another similar device; door alerts interest me more than an older speaker or another power strip.",
    "Interest alone does not mean I am ready to buy: I need a concrete use for a monitor or adapter, and I would start small when trying home security."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my Alexa and computer-accessory interests but miss the exact compatibility, existing equipment, and immediate purpose that determine what I would choose next."
}
